transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... I guess what finally made me ask for help is just... I keep forgetting little things. Stuff I normally handle. Just, like, returning calls, or... turning in a registration form. Or remembering to stop for an errand on the way home. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you had trouble with attention or forgetfulness like this since you were a child?

Yeah... I suppose so. Even back in elementary school. I guess I was always the kid forgetting permission slips, or... losing my homework down in my backpack somewhere. Um... I usually needed my mom or the teacher to remind me, like, step by step just to finish projects. So... yes.
Do these attention or forgetfulness problems cause trouble for you in more than one part of your life, such as both at work and at home?

Um... yeah. Both, I guess. I mean, I’m still getting by mostly. But... I've missed a few small follow-ups at work lately. And some school deadlines. It's just... it happens enough that I worry about my reputation. I've been hoping to move up into an Office Manager role eventually, and... I just don't want this to mess up my chances. So, yeah. Both.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
No... not really. I mean, I get frustrated sometimes when I forget things, but... I wouldn't say I feel depressed. Just... annoyed with myself, mostly.
As a child, were you often fidgety or unable to sit still?
No, not really. I was pretty quiet, actually. I mean, I might have daydreamed a lot, but... I didn't have trouble sitting still.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things?
No, not really. I mean, I guess I worry about work sometimes, like I said, but... not about a lot of different things. Just the normal stuff.
